Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Utkarsha Utpal, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Parmeshwar Mehta, APP

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 4 21-04-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Bahera P.S. Case No. 218 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

As per the prosecution case, The petitioner is Assistant Manager of T.P.D.S godown, Benipur and on the order of District Magistrate, Darbhanga, inspected the godown and it was found that total 547.68520 quintals rice and 1125.4482 quintals wheat have been embezzled, amounting to Rs.
19,72,762 and 28,20,373, which is recoverable from the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.72122 of 2022(4) dt.21-04-2023 petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that petitioner is innocent and he has committed no offence.
When verification was conducted by the officer, petitioner, was not present there.

It is further submitted that the petitioner as per instruction and guidelines of the department used to physically inspect the godown and send monthly gains statement and monthly inspection report to Headquarter and no complain has ever been made against the petitioner till date.

It is further submitted that in absence Anshuman Rai vs The State Of Bihar on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120482128/
1 of the petitioner, breaking the lock of the godown, and stock list of food grains has been prepared without verifying the stock register and deficiency has been shown without any explanation from the petitioner.
Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submitted that after inquiry it is found that total 547.68520 quintals rice and 1125.4482 quintals wheat have been embezzled, amounting to Rs. 19,72,762 and 28,20,373 /-.

Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.72122 of 2022(4) dt.21-04-2023

However, if petitioner surrenders before the learned court below within a period of six weeks from today, and pray for regular bail, the learned court below shall consider the prayer for regular bail of the petitioner, preferably, on the same day without being prejudiced by this order.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) N.K/-
